templates.name: CrmDashboard

templates.name: CrmContactList
templates.description: Contacts with their company, owner, status and last contact, filtered by owner, status, source and creation date.

templates.name: CrmCompanyList
templates.description: Companies with their industry, owner, status and last contact, filtered by owner, status, source and creation date.

templates.name: CrmDealPipeline
templates.description: Deals as cards in a column for each stage, each stage showing its total value.

templates.name: CrmDealList
templates.description: Every deal as a table grouped by stage, with the value of each stage as its subtotal.

templates.name: CrmActivityList
templates.description: Calls, meetings, emails and tasks with their owner, status and date.

templates.description: One contact: key facts, their fields, their deals and the activity with them.

templates.name: CrmDealPage
templates.description: One deal: stage, value and close date, its fields, the contacts involved and the activity on it.
